## Summary

Describe the problem, scope, and intended result. Link the issue and numbered spec when applicable.

## Validation

List exact commands, environment, exit codes, pass/fail/skip counts, and reasons for checks not run. Describe manual checks and remaining risks. Do not mark an unrun check as passed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and the code of conduct.
- [ ] I preserved the paper-only boundary and did not use account credentials or submit orders in default tests.
- [ ] I added or updated regression tests and affected documentation, or explained why they are not needed.
- [ ] I added a changelog fragment for a meaningful change and a numbered spec for non-trivial work.
- [ ] I checked applicable accessibility behavior, including keyboard use, labels, focus, contrast, feedback, and generated output, or explained why it is not applicable.
- [ ] I removed secrets, account identifiers, private journal data, and runtime files from the change and evidence.
- [ ] I preserved applicable licenses and attribution.

## Limitations and follow-up

Record known failures, skips, untested platforms, and any follow-up. Suspected vulnerabilities belong in the private SECURITY.md process, not here.
